limitations.note: The rewrite turns red on during reset and removes the staged startup sequence, whereas the reference fix only registers the light outputs and preserves the all-off reset and existing pipeline.
The test assumes immediate red on reset and a direct countdown from there, so its passing result cannot catch the mismatch with the expected all-off reset and pipelined startup.
